title: A protocol to visualize cytosolic aggresome-like bodies using confocal microscopy
protocol: Seed approximately 2 × 10^5 HeLa cells in 2 mL of Minimum Essential Medium (MEM) in a confocal glass bottom dish.
Allow the seeded HeLa cells to attach for 20–24 hours.
Culture HeLa cells in MEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and without antibiotics.
Ensure cell confluency reaches at least 70% at 24 hours post-seeding.
Avoid using media supplemented with antibiotics during the culture of HeLa cells for this experiment.
Seed cells using at least 1.2 × 10^5–1.8 × 10^5 cells in each confocal dish and allow attachment for 24 h prior to transfection.
Dilute Tubacin to a final concentration of 10 μM in MEM supplemented with 10% FBS (MEM-Tubacin).
Change the medium to MEM-Tubacin.
Incubate cells for 12 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.
Remove media from dishes.
Dilute MG132 to a final concentration of 5 μM, MLN4924 to a final concentration of 3 μM, or use a combination of MG132 and MLN4924 in MEM-Tubacin.
Change the medium to MEM-Tubacin with inhibitors.
Incubate inhibitor-treated cells for 12 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.
Carefully remove the medium from dishes after treating HeLa cells with inhibitors for 12 h.
Wash cells once with 1× PBS at 25°C and remove residual PBS.
Fix the cells with 1 ml of 4% PFA for 15 min at 25°C.
Wash the cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 min each.
Pause the protocol after fixing cells in PFA.
Store fixed cells in 1× PBS at 4°C up to 1 week for the next step.
Add 1 mL of permeabilization buffer to the cells for 15 min at 25°C to permeabilize the cell membrane.
Remove permeabilization buffer and add 1 mL of blocking buffer for 30 min at 25°C to block non-specific binding.
Wash cells once with 1× PBS after blocking period to remove residual blocking buffer.
Dilute NEDD8 and HDAC6 antibodies at a ratio of 1:500 in blocking buffer.
Mix diluted primary antibodies by inverting or vortexing, then spin down for a second.
Add 100 μL of the diluted primary antibody solution to the cells.
Cover dishes with clear wrap and foil to prevent drying of the antibody solution.
Incubate the dishes stationary at 4°C for 12–16 h.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 min each after incubation period.
Dilute Alexa Fluor-conjugated secondary antibodies at a ratio of 1:500 using blocking buffer.
Mix diluted secondary antibodies by inverting or vortexing, then spin down for a second.
Add 100 μL of the diluted secondary antibodies solution to the cells.
Incubate dishes covered with foil in the dark to protect from light and prevent photobleaching.
Incubate for 1–2 hours at 25°C.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 minutes each.
Dilute DAPI in 1× PBS to a final concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Add 200 μL of diluted DAPI solution.
Incubate for 15–30 minutes at 25°C.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 minutes each.
Remove the PBS from dishes.
Add 50 μL of mounting solution.
Cover the cells with a 12-mm cover glass.
Process images using NIS-Element AR software to adjust their intensity.
Scan cells stained with DAPI.
Capture images of at least 5 fields for quantification of ALB-containing cells.
Save acquired images as ".nd2" files.
Export images to the Tagged Image File Format.
